task_definition.description: Web scraping example using Playwright to extract data from a webpage

compute_logic.code:
import json
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def scrape_website():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        # Navigate to a news or content site
        await page.goto('https://corebrum.com', wait_until='networkidle')
        
        # Extract structured data
        data = {
            'title': await page.title(),
            'url': page.url,
            'headings': [],
            'links': [],
            'paragraphs': []
        }
        
        # Extract all headings
        headings = await page.query_selector_all('h1, h2, h3')
        for heading in headings[:10]:  # Limit to first 10
            text = await heading.inner_text()
            tag = await heading.evaluate('el => el.tagName')
            data['headings'].append({'tag': tag, 'text': text.strip()})
        
        # Extract links
        links = await page.query_selector_all('a[href]')
        for link in links[:20]:  # Limit to first 20
            href = await link.get_attribute('href')
            text = await link.inner_text()
            if href and text:
                data['links'].append({'url': href, 'text': text.strip()[:50]})
        
        # Extract paragraphs
        paragraphs = await page.query_selector_all('p')
        for para in paragraphs[:5]:  # Limit to first 5
            text = await para.inner_text()
            if text.strip():
                data['paragraphs'].append(text.strip()[:200])
        
        await browser.close()
        
        return data

result = asyncio.run(scrape_website())
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
